data.name: Junius
data.gender_notes: Junius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'junior', meaning 'young'. In ancient Rome, Junius was a surname given to younger sons of a family. The name Junius carries the meaning “Juvenile, young” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Junius usually hope their child will grow to embody juvenile, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, youth, and vitality.
data.etymology: Junius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Juvenile, young.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Junius total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וניוס

in_greek.name: Ιούνιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Ιούνιος έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρχαία Ρώμη και σημαίνει 'γεννημένος τον Ιούνιο' ή 'νέος'. Ο μήνας Ιούνιος είναι ο έκτος μήνας του έτους και πήρε το όνομά του από τη ρωμαϊκή θεά Juno. Στην Χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Ιούνιος χρησιμοποιείται ως ανδρικό όνομα.

in_latin.name: Junius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Junius originates from ancient Rome, derived from 'juvenis,' meaning 'young' or 'youthful.' It is also associated with the month of June, which was named after the Roman goddess Juno. In Christian tradition, Junius is used as a given name for males, symbolizing youth and vitality.

in_english.name: Junius
in_english.meaning: Young one, born in June, youthful
in_english.long_meaning: The name Junius has its roots in ancient Rome, derived from the Latin word 'juvenis,' meaning 'young' or 'youthful.' It is associated with the month of June, which was named after the Roman goddess Juno. In Christian tradition, Junius is used as a given name for males, symbolizing youth, vitality, and spiritual renewal. The name has been used historically in various Christian cultures, reflecting its Latin origins and significance.

Ultimately, Junius can serve as inspiration for embracing our role in the grand Christian tradition, whether as a young believer or as a mentor to those coming after us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Junius, derived from the Roman family name Junius, symbolizes strength, loyalty, and wisdom rooted in ancient tradition. Spiritually, it represents the inner journey of a Christ follower, seeking guidance from the past to build a strong foundation for the future.
